description: Get official WTA singles, doubles and Race rankings, player profiles, match history, or the tournament calendar from wtatennis.com.

fromDate.description: Tournaments mode. Start of the calendar window; leave empty for the last 7 days.
fromDate.title: From date

includeRankingHistory.description: Player profiles mode. Add up to 52 weeks of singles, doubles and Race ranking history.
includeRankingHistory.title: Include ranking history

includeTournamentMatches.description: Tournaments mode. Add the match list for every returned tournament.
includeTournamentMatches.title: Include tournament matches

level.description: Tournaments mode. Filter by WTA tournament tier.
level.title: Tournament level

maxItems.description: Stop after this many records. Each ranking table has at most about 1,800 players.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Choose rankings, player profiles, match history, or the tournament calendar.
mode.title: What to scrape

nationality.description: Three-letter country code such as USA, POL, or KAZ.
nationality.title: Nationality (optional)

playerIds.description: Profiles and matches modes. Paste WTA player IDs or profile URLs, one per line or comma-separated.
playerIds.title: Player IDs or profile URLs (optional)

rankingDate.description: Historical rankings as of a Monday from 2001 onward. Leave empty for the latest published rankings.
rankingDate.title: Ranking date (optional)

rankingType.description: Singles, doubles, Race to the WTA Finals singles, or Race to the WTA Finals doubles. Also used to resolve names in profiles and matches modes.
enumTitles: Race to the WTA Finals - Singles
Race to the WTA Finals - Doubles
rankingType.title: Ranking table

searchQuery.description: Filter rankings by name, or resolve players for profiles and matches modes.
searchQuery.title: Player name (optional)

surface.description: Tournaments mode. Filter by court surface.
surface.title: Surface

toDate.description: Tournaments mode. End of the calendar window; leave empty for the next 14 days.
toDate.title: To date

year.description: Matches mode only. Limit match history to one season, for example 2026.
year.title: Season (optional)

title: WTA Rankings, Player Profiles, Matches & Tournaments Input
